name: Mimic — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Mimic from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Mimic, Mindslave" but are not part of the Mimic entry, which is unchanged.

Supple Shifter (Ex)

The mimic can squeeze into a space as small as 1/4 its base size. Its reach increases by 5 feet and it gains Combat Reflexes as a bonus feat.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

After a mindslave mimic is slain and its protoplasm relaxes, a gray-green “patch” identifiable as a mindslave harness becomes visible. PCs who make a successful DC 20 Craft (alchemy) or Heal check can determine it represents a form of organic mind-control used to enslave the mimic.
